name: pi-ext-int-search
description: Hardened fork of nicobailon/pi-web-access (synced to v0.35.0) with unified proxy mode + destination-first key binding + added internal search. EXTERNAL: web_search across OpenAI, Brave, Parallel, TinyFish, Search1API, Searchinfinity, Querit, Tavily, Firecrawl, Crawl4AI, Jina, SERPdive, Kagi, Ollama, AnySearch, Bright Data, SerpBase, SerpApi, Serply, You.com, SearXNG, Exa, Perplexity, Gemini, Kimi, Mistral, Z.ai (URL fetch raw/answer modes, GitHub clone + PR/issue, PDF, YouTube/video, source_check). INTERNAL: memory_search over your own pi chat sessions, claude-recall memories, project docs, and git history.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && node scripts/pi-extensions-dist.js dist

author: Nico Bailon (original), axelbaumlisto (ext+int fork)
